meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Get in touch by email, phone, or the form on this page.

hero.title: Get in touch
hero.subtitle: Send a message and we will answer the same working day.

form.name: Your name
form.subject: Subject
form.consent: I have read the <1>privacy policy</1> and agree that my details will be used to answer this enquiry.

status.sentBody: Thank you. We will reply to the address you gave, usually within one working day.
status.invalidBody: Some fields need attention before this can be sent.
status.rateLimitedBody: Please wait about {{minutes}} minutes before trying again, or call us instead.
status.timeoutBody: The message did not go through. Please try again, or contact us directly using the details below.
status.networkBody: Something went wrong on the way. Please try again, or contact us directly using the details below.
status.serverTitle: Something went wrong at our end
status.serverBody: The message did not go through and the fault is ours. Please contact us directly using the details below.
status.unavailableTitle: The form is not available right now
status.unavailableBody: We cannot take messages through this page at the moment. Please email or call us. Those reach us as reliably as ever.
status.demoNotice: Demo form: messages are not delivered yet. Until it is connected, use the phone number or email on this page.

name.tooShort: That looks too short to be a name.
name.tooLong: That is longer than we can store. Please shorten it.

email.required: We need an email address to reply to.
email.invalid: That does not look like an email address.
email.tooShort: That does not look like an email address.
email.tooLong: That address is longer than an email address can be.

phone.invalid: A phone number can only contain digits, spaces and + ( ) - .
phone.tooShort: That is too short to be a phone number.
phone.tooLong: That is too long to be a phone number.

subject.required: Please give the message a subject.
subject.tooShort: Please write a slightly longer subject.

message.tooShort: Please add a little more detail, so we can help you properly.
message.tooLong: That is longer than we can accept. Please shorten it, or send it by email instead.

consent.required: We need your agreement before we can use your details to reply.

details.title: Or reach us directly
